title.zh: 将甲米地省达斯马里尼亚斯市镇达斯马里尼亚斯安置中心中学的名称变更为达斯马里尼亚斯国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Dasmariñas Relocation Center High School in the Municipality of Dasmariñas, Province of Cavite, to Dasmariñas National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Dasmariñas Relocation Center High School in the Municipality of Dasmariñas, Province of Cavite, to Dasmariñas National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Dasmariñas Relocation Center tại Thị trấn Dasmariñas, Tỉnh Cavite thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Dasmariñas
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Dasmariñas Relocation Center ในเทศบาล Dasmariñas, จังหวัด Cavite เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Dasmariñas
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Dasmariñas Relocation Center di Kotamadya Dasmariñas, Provinsi Cavite menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Dasmariñas
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Dasmariñas Relocation Center di Perbandaran Dasmariñas, Wilayah Cavite menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Dasmariñas

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7713_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Dasmariñas Relocation Center High School in the Municipality of Dasmariñas, Province of Cavite, is hereby changed to Dasmariñas National High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
